description: How fast a large UK company pays its suppliers. From the company's statutory Payment Practices reports (OGL v3) — average days to pay, share paid late against agreed terms, terms, trend over its last reports, benchmark against all recent reporters, and a plain reading for suppliers. 1 credit. A name also returns otherMatches (other reporting companies it matches, by number). Use this for the payment record itself and its benchmark; for what the lateness is worth on your own invoice use will_they_pay, and for the PPN 018 and Fair Payment Code tests use ppn_018.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.

title: Supplier Payment Practices
